longDescription:
Note: Looking for Immediate Joiners only. This is for a contract role and please apply who are interested for contract role.

  • Technical expertise in Enterprise Data Governance implementing enterprise data standards, controls, and governance processes.
  • Establish end-to-end data lineage frameworks across enterprise data platforms.
  • Implement governance controls within modern data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Data Management Capability Assessment
  • Design and maintain enterprise metadata and Data repositories with taxonomy standards.
  • Enterprise Data Asset Inventory
  • Data Governance, data classification, and Security knowledge
  • Data Remediation process

  • ITSM integration

    Additionally, for a typical Data Governance individual, we understand that he needs to have experience with the following:

  • Design and maintain enterprise metadata repositories and taxonomy standards.
  • Establish end-to-end data lineage frameworks across enterprise data platforms.
  • Define key data quality metrics, scorecards, and monitoring mechanisms.

  • Ensure compliance with data privacy and regulatory requirements including GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX, BCBS 239, and industry-specific regulations.

    Technical Skills:

  • Snowflake
  • Informatica
  • MS Purview
  • BIG ID
  • AWS Data Services
  • MS Share point
  • SQL

  • Power BI

    Governance Capabilities

  • Data Cataloging
  • Data Quality Frameworks
  • Data Lineage
  • Metadata Management
  • Reference Data Management
  • Master Data Management
  • Data Security & Privacy

  • Data Classification

    Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Management, or related field.

  • 8-15+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or related disciplines.

    Deep experience and understanding of:

  • DCAM (Data Management Capability Assessment Model)
  • Data Stewardship
  • Data Lineage
  • Data Privacy and Compliance
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
